description: This file defines the CredentialsInterface for AWS SDK in PHP, specifying methods for accessing AWS credentials such as access key ID, secret key, security token, and expiration details.

classes.name: CredentialsInterface
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to access AWS credentials including access key ID, secret key, security token, expiration, and conversion to array.

methods.name: getAccessKeyId
methods.description: Returns the AWS access key ID for this credentials object.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Returns the AWS secret access key for this credentials object.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Get the associated security token if available.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Get the UNIX timestamp in which the credentials will expire.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Check if the credentials are expired.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the credentials to an associative array.
